text: Series A deck — 10 sections | CSOAI | CSOAI Home Benchmarks Scorecard Data room Deck Series A deck — 10 sections | CSOAI 2026-08-09 · CSOAI — measurement, not claim · generated from signed artefacts 1 · Problem AI governance compliance is a paperwork theatre: human audit shops, dashboards and certification bodies that cannot re-run a single number. The EU AI Act high-risk deadline is August 2026 — now . Nobody owns the measurement layer. Nobody makes it sovereign. 2 · Deadline The regulator's clock is the wedge: Article 5 prohibitions bite today; high-risk obligations roll in from Aug 2026. Buyers need a number they can show an auditor — measured, signed, recompute-able. That is the product. 3 · Product "SOV as the Moody's of AI". We run the tests, we own the data, everyone else cites the scores. Live now: /benchmarks + /scorecard — free dashboard, Pro API, Enterprise audits, measured badges. 4 · Traction (measured today) Care-gate recall 100% · over-block 0% on 76 items 137 signed refutation-ledger records (the evidence of honesty) 9/9 live surfaces 200 · AI-SEO kit complete on 3 domains · overnight loop 100+ cycles Free-tier substrate end-to-end — the unit economics work before revenue, not after 5 · Market AI governance: $1.1B → $13.1B by 2035 (31.4% CAGR). Humanoid robotics adjacent. Nobody owns full-stack sovereign measurement; this is the greenfield no one else can claim with a working instrument. 6 · Model Free public benchmark = moat + network effect. Pro API $0.01/query · Enterprise audits $50K · measured badge $5K/run (a measurement, not a certification). The scorecard is the funnel; the data room is the proof. 7 · Team Founder-driven sovereign lab: measurement engine, attestation chain, fleet, and the public surfaces are built and live. Execution speed visible in this repo's own history — and the refutation ledger proves we correct, not conceal. 8 · Financials £1.5M seed bridge → £15–30M Series A in 9 months. Cost base is free-tier + spot GPU (caps per run); the instrument is the asset, not burn. Revenue starts at the first Enterprise audit, not at the first enterprise hire. 9 · Ask £1.5M Seed Bridge @ £4.5M pre — 25% dilution, 75% retained → Seed Q4 (£2M @ £8M) → Series A Q2-2027 (£15–30M). Lead investor, you ship the ask to your own compliance review. Use of funds: productize the three audit packs → first 3 enterprise pilots → the Series-A evidence creates the uplisting, not the reverse. 10 · Vision The SimCity-of-the-world: every governance decision observable, every play a signed evidence record feeding the measurement flywheel. Measure → sign → verify, at global scale. CSOAI Ltd · UK company 16939677 · Every published figure traces to a signed, verifiable record.
